headline: Mibanco Projects S/5.78 Billion in Microfinance Disbursals for Q4
summary: Mibanco projects disbursing S/ 5,782.9 million between October and December 2026, driven by higher commercial activity and working capital needs among micro and small enterprises during the Christmas season.
why: Microfinance lending volumes indicate retail and small business credit demand in emerging economies during peak seasonal periods.
